gloss: to establish; to found; to set up

definitions.gloss: to establish; to found; to set up (an organization or institution)
definitions.explanation: To officially create a new organization, company, institution, or system. Implies formal, deliberate creation with legal or institutional backing.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{会社|かいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}した。
この{大学|だいがく}は1900{年|ねん}に{設立|せつりつ}された。
{地域|ちいき}の{問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}するために、{住民|じゅうみん}が{協力|きょうりょく}してNPOを{設立|せつりつ}した。
examples.english: To solve local problems, residents cooperated to establish an NPO.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for the formal creation of organizations, institutions, and companies. Not used for casual or personal projects. The noun form {設立|せつりつ} is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {会社|かいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}する (to establish a company)
- {法人|ほうじん}を{設立|せつりつ}する (to establish a corporation)
- {委員会|いいんかい}を{設立|せつりつ}する (to set up a committee)
- {設立|せつりつ}{年|ねん} (year of establishment)
- {設立|せつりつ}{者|しゃ} (founder)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {創立|そうりつ}: to found — very similar, but emphasizes being the first to create something
- {創業|そうぎょう}: to start a business — specifically about starting commercial operations
- {設置|せっち}: to set up, to install — used for physical things or departments within organizations
